scope: Read-only assessment of existing receipts for one male outfit, parallel 20 mm. No approval issued.
bindingRecipeDistinction: binding.recipeSha256 hashes the editable shoe recipe. The two character integrity.recipeSha256 values hash the complete appearance recipe.

records.origin: original stable actor, flat revision 2 loaded then platform saved as revision 3
new stable actor produced from the diagnostic batch, revision 1

terminology.record: character-record-v1 integrity SHA-256; both envelopes validated by validateCharacterRecord from fixed checkout. This grants content integrity and graph identity.
terminology.candidate: Technical testing on the development PC and a usable exported package are evidenced. The diagnostic batch emitted candidate=1, rejected=1, accepted=0. The producer receipt says validated-before-publication.
terminology.formal: runtime-admitted/accepted requires a pinned passed whole-outfit review in the production tool index and an exact fixed checkout/source. The candidate matrix row already provides recipeSource and its hash. No new row status or global reclassification of the shoe is required for an exact reviewed whole outfit.
terminology.runtimeReview: The reviewed-game-character-runtime-v1 inventory authenticates this game build for export. It does not approve an outfit or visual quality.

items.reason: Whole-outfit runtime admission evidence is required from the reviewed index

wholeOutfitRoom.diagnostic: ValueError: Room used a different record or an incomplete action chain

equipmentFit.reuse: Exact body, source flat shoe, six skin bindings, original upper and body preservation, platform mesh, independently regenerated bytes and measured contact on this body. Fit JSON records runtimeAccepted=false.
equipmentFit.open: Attach the pinned whole-outfit fit basis for top, pants and shoe to a reviewed receipt; previous issuance or shared body alone confers no approval.

normalSpeedMotion.reuse: Same fixed source and body. Room tests both looks and swap in one run; existing platform footage can support human review.
normalSpeedMotion.open: verify_room_report expects the exact revision 3 SHA loaded/restored before the four completed tasks walk/sit/stand/walk and associated .webm. The observed source record is flat revision 2, followed by live change and derivation of revision 3; its report contains 12 tasks and status technical-pass-visual-pending. Keep it as contact evidence.

recordAndRestore.reuse: Package inventory already pins build, exact revision 3, body and all equipment; two full cold sessions verify the actual shoe GLB, visible positions/indices, four weighted patches, running bones and fresh actor roots.
recordAndRestore.open: Verifier requires first and reopened state for that record with sha/expectedSha/body plus actual look, props, materials and hairCenter comparisons, build identity and game resource failures. Cold probe captures the shoe-specific subset. qa-production-package.cjs currently asserts two records; this requirement belongs to the runner, not the admission contract.

selectionGuards.reuse: Female missing-fit rejection, isolated candidate item, transaction/cancel/rollback measurement, and visible-shoe restore show different portions of the selection path.
selectionGuards.open: Collect exact record recipe SHA, resourceIdentities and visible entire outfit in before/reopened states, real rejected edit preserving current actor and valid recover/retry. Existing guard runner assumes two distinct bodies and socks or top with specific roles; it cannot directly accept a single platform record as a shoe guard. No such exact guard receipt located.

runtimeRecordAndBudget.reuse: Exact revision 3 class and static aggregate fit, transport/mesh/texture accounting. Existing probe observes a development GPU renderer and shoe transfer, not a whole-process decode or GPU lifecycle budget.
runtimeRecordAndBudget.open: No native-budget-admission-v1 passed for exact body/record across transport, decodeCanvas, gpu and ordinaryPC; ordinary-PC measurements and transient resource behavior remain open. Bring forward static measurements at their existing scope.

humanVisualReview.reuse: Existing normal-speed platform and flat clips and close seated swap. User accepts minor intersections when motion is continuous; observed maximum dance depression is recorded for review.
humanVisualReview.open: No human disposition for this exact sample/film identified. General instruction sets the criterion; a report or measured depth alone cannot provide the person-specific acceptance. No numerical zero-contact gate.

provenanceAndRights.reuse: Authored/base/derived geometry and provenance follow the CC0 male source, its published third-party export, correct editable shoe and recipe, original author credit and actual equipment entries; retain provenance of all pieces and their byte pins.
provenanceAndRights.open: Attach checked source/rights to the specific receipt, preserving source statement and attribution scope. No missing purchase or new external permission was established in this audit.

constraints: Same appearance recipe and equipment across new producer revision 1 and original actor revision 3 do not transfer record-specific proofs.
Ordinary-PC testing remains an open formal budget layer and does not prevent describing measured technical behavior on the development machine.
Production index pin, exact runtime/build metadata and seven passed evidence lanes must match. Scope excludes other bodies, shoe heights, heel pitch and future builds.
